hooks.command: c=$(cat); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq 'studio-configs[\\/]+(CLAUDE\.md|settings\.json)|\.claude[\\/]+(CLAUDE\.md|settings(\.local)?\.json)' || exit 0; c=$(printf '%s' "$c" | sed -E 's#2?>&?[0-9]*[[:space:]]*/dev/null##g'); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eq '(>|\btee\b|\bmv\b|\bcp\b|\brm\b|\bdd\b|\btruncate\b|\binstall\b|\bpython3?\b|\bnode\b|\bperl\b|sed +-i)' || exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Config protegee : ce fichier est deja en deny pour Edit. Y ecrire via Bash contournerait la regle. Presenter la modification a l utilisateur pour qu il l applique lui-meme."}}'

c=$(cat); t=$(printf '%s' "$c" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // .tool_input.new_string // ""'); p=$(printf '%s' "$c" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); printf '%s' "$t" | grep -q '—' && { printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Tiret cadratin interdit. Remplacer selon le role reel dans la phrase : deux-points s il introduit, virgule s il oppose, parentheses s il incise, point si la phrase peut se couper. Ne pas substituer mecaniquement."}}'; exit 0; }; printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Eiq '[\\/]Temp[\\/]claude[\\/].*[\\/]scratchpad[\\/]' && exit 0; printf '%s' "$t" | grep -Eiq '\\u\{?0{0,4}2014\}?|\\x\{2014\}|\\N\{EM DASH\}|0x2014|—|—|—|chr\(8212\)|fromCharCode\(8212\)|\[char\]8212' && { printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Tiret cadratin ecrit par un detour (sequence d echappement, code du caractere ou entite HTML) : meme regle que le caractere en clair. Un script de nettoyage qui doit nommer ce caractere pour le retirer s ecrit dans le scratchpad de la session (Temp/claude/.../scratchpad), seul endroit ou ces formes sont admises."}}'; exit 0; }; exit 0

g=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-garde-config; id=$(jq -r '.tool_use_id // empty'); case $id in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) exit 0;; esac; find "$g" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -mmin +10 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p "$g/$id" || exit 0; for f in settings.json CLAUDE.md; do cp "$HOME/.claude/$f" "$g/$id/$f" 2>/dev/null; done; exit 0

g=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-garde-config; id=$(jq -r '.tool_use_id // empty'); case $id in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) exit 0;; esac; d=$g/$id; [ -d "$d" ] || exit 0; m=; s=; for f in settings.json CLAUDE.md; do [ -f "$d/$f" ] || continue; cmp -s "$d/$f" "$HOME/.claude/$f" && continue; if [ ! -s "$d/$f" ] || { [ $f = settings.json ] && ! jq empty "$d/$f" 2>/dev/null; }; then s="$s $f"; continue; fi; t=$(readlink -f "$HOME/.claude/$f") || continue; cp "$d/$f" "$t.garde-$id" && mv -f "$t.garde-$id" "$t" || cat "$d/$f" > "$t" && m="$m $f"; rm -f "$t.garde-$id"; done; rm -rf "$d"; [ -n "$m$s" ] || exit 0; r=; [ -z "$m" ] || r="Garde de la config : modification de$m pendant cet appel d outil, version precedente restauree."; [ -z "$s" ] || r="${r:+$r }Garde de la config : copie de sauvegarde vide ou invalide pour$s, rien restaure."; jq -n --arg m "$r Verifier git status dans studio-configs." '{decision:"block",reason:$m,systemMessage:$m}'

'{decision:"block",reason:$m,systemMessage:$m}'
cat >/dev/null; g=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-garde-config; [ -n "$(find "$g" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -mmin -10 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ] && printf '%s' '{"decision":"block"}'; exit 0
